column1: # Skills this config uses but does not vendor.
# These belong to other people. Rather than copying them into this repo —
# which would redistribute them and freeze them at whatever revision they
# happened to be on — install.sh links them from where their owner installs
# them. Run install.sh again after updating a source to pick up changes.
#   hunk     ships inside the hunk binary; path from `hunk skill path`.
# Recorded upstream revision for pocock at last install:
#   6654f6b feat: add 'Information access' category to retrospective skill
# grilling, grill-me, and to-tickets are NOT linked from pocock any more: this
# repo carries hand-authored forks in agents/skills/ — grilling drives the
# question_round UI, to-tickets adds the ticket schema and super-tickets.
